title: ForgeCycle roadmap questions response
description: The Decomposer's answer to roadmap questions: rewrites of the decisions the human marked unclear, under their own IDs, and decisions a roadmap's Planners and Reviewers would stop to ask that its decisions document does not hold yet, which ForgeCycle numbers after the document's highest Q ID and appends as open decisions (ADR 0028). Each question has the fields of a decomposition question (decomposition.schema.json#/$defs/question).

clarified.description: Exactly the decisions in UNCLEAR_DECISIONS, each once, rewritten to answer what the human marked unclear
